description: This file defines the ImageRenderer class responsible for rendering images into RTF format within the MigraDoc PDF/RTF rendering system. It handles image dimensions, source types, and embedding image byte data, supporting various image formats and resource images.

classes.name: ImageRenderer
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for rendering images into RTF format, managing image attributes, source, dimensions, and positioning within the document.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render the image as RTF, handling context placement and invoking image rendering steps.

methods.name: RenderImage
methods.description: Handles rendering of image description, attributes, and byte data into the RTF output.

methods.name: StartImageDescription
methods.description: Starts the RTF description block for the image, either inline or as a shape.

methods.name: EndImageDescription
methods.description: Ends the image description block in RTF.

methods.name: RenderImageAttributes
methods.description: Handles rendering of image-related attributes like shape type, fill, line, size, and source.

methods.name: RenderSourceType
methods.description: Determines and writes the correct RTF control for the image source type.

methods.name: RenderDimensionSettings
methods.description: Calculates and writes size and scaling controls for the image.

methods.name: CalculateImageDimensions
methods.description: Attempts to load the image, determine its dimensions, resolution, and aspect ratio, with error handling.

methods.name: GetFileExtension
methods.description: Extracts and returns the file extension type of the image source, handling base64 data and resource images.

methods.name: RenderByteSeries
methods.description: Writes the image binary data into the RTF as a hexadecimal byte series.

methods.name: GetShapeHeight
methods.description: Calculates the scaled height of the image.

methods.name: GetShapeWidth
methods.description: Calculates the scaled width of the image.

methods.name: RenderCropping
methods.description: Adds cropping settings to the image if specified.
